method: pso_lib FK of robot_allcollisions.xml; hip pitch over its full range in 2 deg steps; knee at 0/25/50/75/100 % of the flexion half-range; ankle at 0, level with the torso floor, and both range ends; hip yaw and roll at 0 and +-10 deg; exact manifold3d min_gap of the thigh/knee, shin and ankle/foot bodies (hip yaw/roll bodies once per yaw/roll); first contact = first hip-pitch step from 0 in the nose-down direction with gap < 1 mm
nose_down_definition: hip-pitch sign that moves the foot backward (-x) in the torso frame = torso pitching nose-down over a planted foot; with a vertical thigh the hip-pitch angle equals the torso pitch

solids.pack: Layout L pack solid, plate trimmed to the original power_support silhouette (finalps25)
solids.baseline: original battery + original power_support (union of the guide-frame meshes)

gap_estimate.baseline_first_contacts: field estimate (exact at the summary rows in reach-pitch.json)

conventions.ankle_level_rule: ankle = -(s_hp*hip_pitch + s_kn*knee)/s_an, clipped to the ankle range (foot sole parallel to the torso-frame floor)

contact.note: field estimate < 1 mm but exact gap >= 1 mm here; reported angle is the field estimate (exact gap given)
